events.description: Join @materialgworlmpls as we honor the Black women and femmes who took their expression of personal style through music, hair, and fashion to the next level and man an undeniable impact on popular culture of the late early 90s through the 2000s! Enjoy the best in booty bouncing beats from DJ IBIBABY all night plus pop up drag performances by PRISCILLA ES YUICY, CARIÑO, KEN DOLL, & SPLASH!
